title: Cloaca
blurb: A cloaca, pl.: cloacae, or vent, is the rear orifice that serves as the only opening for the digestive (rectum), reproductive, and urinary tracts of many vertebrate animals.
facts: Excretory openings with analogous purpose in some invertebrates are also sometimes called cloacae.
Mating through the cloaca is called cloacal copulation and cloacal kissing.
